projects.title: Morais City Website Redesign
projects.shortDescription: A modern real-estate experience designed to simplify property discovery and showcase the Morais City lifestyle.
projects.summary:
Morais City is a large-scale integrated township in Trichy, offering residential properties, commercial spaces, retail opportunities, entertainment and lifestyle amenities in one destination.

I redesigned the Morais City website to create a more structured, modern and conversion-focused digital experience. The goal was to make it easier for users to discover properties, understand the township ecosystem, explore individual projects and take action through clear enquiry and contact touchpoints.

The redesign focused on improving information hierarchy, navigation, property discovery, visual storytelling and responsive UI patterns while maintaining the premium positioning of the Morais City brand.

The experience brings residential, commercial and lifestyle offerings into a clearer digital journey, helping prospective buyers, investors and visitors move from discovery to project exploration and enquiry with less friction.

workflow.title: Discovery & Audit
workflow.description: Reviewed the existing website, content structure and user journeys to identify usability gaps, navigation issues and opportunities to improve property discovery.

workflow.title: Information Architecture
workflow.description: Reorganized the content around key user needs — residential properties, commercial spaces, amenities, projects and enquiries — creating a more intuitive information hierarchy.

workflow.title: UX Flow & Wireframes
workflow.description: Defined key user flows and page structures before moving into high-fidelity UI, focusing on reducing friction between property discovery and enquiry.

workflow.title: Visual Design
workflow.description: Created a premium, modern interface system with structured layouts, strong typography, property-focused imagery, clear CTAs and reusable UI components.

workflow.title: Responsive Design
workflow.description: Designed responsive layouts to maintain usability and visual consistency across desktop, tablet and mobile screen sizes.

workflow.title: UI Refinement
workflow.description: Refined spacing, hierarchy, interactions and component consistency across the experience to create a cohesive final product.

projects.impactDescription:
The redesign transformed Morais City's digital presence into a clearer, more structured and visually engaging property discovery experience.

The new experience makes it easier for users to understand the Morais City ecosystem, explore residential and commercial offerings, discover amenities and move towards enquiry with clearer calls to action.

The key takeaway was balancing a premium real-estate visual language with practical UX, making a large amount of property information easier to scan, understand and navigate.

projects.title: Morais Altura — High-Rise Apartment Launch Film
projects.shortDescription: Cinematic launch film created from just 4 reference images using an AI-assisted workflow.
projects.summary:
Morais Altura is a high-rise residential project by Morais Group, presented through a cinematic launch film designed to showcase the project's scale, architecture, lifestyle, and key features.

The project started with just four reference images. Instead of relying on traditional production assets, I used an AI-assisted creative workflow to generate additional visual perspectives and supporting scenes, transforming limited static references into a complete promotional film.

I handled the visual direction, AI image generation, scene development, AI video generation, and final editing. The goal was to create a premium real-estate film that feels visually rich and engaging while communicating the project's key selling points through cinematic storytelling.

workflow.title: Reference Selection
workflow.description: Started with four core project images and identified the visual elements that needed to remain consistent.

workflow.title: Visual Expansion
workflow.description: Used AI to create additional perspectives, environments and supporting visuals from the limited references.

workflow.title: Scene Development
workflow.description: Planned individual shots around the project's architecture, location, lifestyle and selling points.

workflow.title: AI Video Generation
workflow.description: Converted selected stills into dynamic cinematic sequences with controlled camera movement and motion.

workflow.title: Editing & Storytelling
workflow.description: Combined the generated clips into a structured launch film with feature callouts, transitions and branding.

workflow.title: Final Refinement
workflow.description: Reviewed the complete sequence and refined the visual flow, pacing and presentation for a polished real-estate launch video.

projects.impactDescription:
With only four initial reference images, I developed a complete cinematic launch film for Morais Altura by combining AI-generated visuals, image-to-video generation and video editing.

The project demonstrates how AI can be integrated into a real creative production workflow to expand limited visual assets into a richer, more engaging marketing film.
projects.finalVerdict:
With only four initial reference images, I developed a complete cinematic launch film for Morais Altura by combining AI-generated visuals, image-to-video generation and video editing.

The project demonstrates how AI can be integrated into a real creative production workflow to expand limited visual assets into a richer, more engaging marketing film.

projects.title: Burj Khalifa vs Altura
projects.shortDescription: End-to-end real estate film from concept, script and storyboard to shoot and final edit.
projects.summary:
Altura Dubai is a real-estate project showcase film created to present the project through a premium and engaging visual narrative. I worked across the complete video production process, starting from the initial concept and script development through storyboard planning, on-location shooting, and final post-production.

The project involved translating the project's key features and selling points into a structured visual story, planning the shots required to communicate the concept effectively, and capturing the footage during production. I then handled the editing and post-production process to bring the individual shots together into a polished final film.

The focus was on creating a visually strong real-estate video that combines clear communication with cinematic presentation, while maintaining consistency in pacing, composition, transitions, and overall brand presentation.

workflow.title: 01 — Concept Development
workflow.description: Defined the purpose of the video, target audience, communication objectives, and overall creative direction.

workflow.title: 02 — Script Development
workflow.description: Created the script and structured the narrative to communicate the project's key features in a clear and engaging way.

workflow.title: 03 — Storyboard & Shot Planning
workflow.description: Translated the script into a visual sequence and planned the required shots, compositions, camera movements, and transitions.

workflow.title: 04 — Production / Shoot
workflow.description: Executed the planned shoot and captured the footage according to the storyboard and visual direction.

workflow.title: 05 — Editing & Post-Production
workflow.description: Selected the strongest footage, built the sequence, refined pacing, and created a cohesive visual narrative.

workflow.title: 06 — Final Delivery
workflow.description: Completed the final visual polish and delivered the finished project showcase film ready for presentation and marketing use.

projects.impactDescription:
This project gave me the opportunity to take complete ownership of a video production workflow — from the initial idea and script to storyboard, production, editing, and final delivery.

Rather than approaching the project purely as an editing task, I worked across the entire creative pipeline to ensure that the concept, visuals, shoot, and final edit worked together as one consistent story.
projects.finalVerdict:
This project gave me the opportunity to take complete ownership of a video production workflow — from the initial idea and script to storyboard, production, editing, and final delivery.

Rather than approaching the project purely as an editing task, I worked across the entire creative pipeline to ensure that the concept, visuals, shoot, and final edit worked together as one consistent story.
